description: This PHP file contains utility functions related to inbound email handling within the SuiteCRM project, including options rendering and signature management.

methods.name: getInboundEmailDistributionOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML options for inbound email distribution settings depending on the view context.

methods.name: getUserSignature
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate user email signature based on context and preferences.

methods.name: getInboundEmailSignatures
methods.description: Constructs an HTML select element listing possible email signatures for a user, optionally selecting a default or current signature.
